review: I had a very disappointing experience with Spinny. I listed my car on OLX for ₹2 lakh. After that, I received a call from Spinny saying the final price could vary by around ₹20,000–30,000, which was completely reasonable. Their mechanic inspected my car for almost 40–50 minutes and even gave it good ratings. But when it came to the final offer, the sales representative completely changed his attitude. Instead of explaining the valuation professionally, he started insulting my car on the call, saying it was "finished" and had no value at all. When I politely refused their offer, he started laughing sarcastically at me. That level of unprofessional behavior is completely unacceptable. I know the value of my car. If Spinny cannot offer the price I'm expecting, that's absolutely fine. But the least they can do is treat customers with basic respect instead of trying to demotivate them into accepting a lowball offer. Strongly not recommended. If you're planning to get your car valued by Spinny, be prepared for psychological tactics and disrespectful sales behavior aimed at making you feel your car is worth far less than it actually is.

title: Spinny Used Car Experience: 8–10 Days in Workshop in First 26 Days
review: I purchased a 2021 Hyundai Verna from Spinny on 17 June 2026. In just 26 days, the car spent 8–10 days in the workshop due to multiple electrical/body-control issues. Problems faced: Battery/starting failure – car would not start and needed roadside assistance with a jump start within 6 days of delivery. Boot/trunk release failure – external button stopped working; trunk could only be opened via the cabin release lever. Trunk latch sensor fault – “trunk open” warning appeared on the instrument cluster even when the boot was closed. Driver door lock switch failure – central locking button becomes non–functional. ORVM fold/unfold switch failure – power-folding mirrors stopped operating. Unsettled Challans Previous fastag was not deactivated What is most concerning is that these issues appeared immediately after the 5-day money-back period expired. A short return window means little if underlying electrical faults surface during normal usage. I request Spinny senior management to review this case seriously. I am spending more time coordinating repairs than driving the car. Prospective buyers should insist on a thorough pre-purchase inspection, verify electrical system health, and carefully assess after-sales support before buying a used car and can also consider others line Cars24, First  Choice etc.

title: I purchased a used Maruti Baleno from…
review: I purchased a used Maruti Baleno from Spinny on 23 June. On the same day, they activated a new FASTag for my vehicle. Since I live near the Bijwasan Toll Plaza, I spend around ₹450 every day on tolls, so I immediately applied for the annual toll pass. To my surprise, my application was rejected because multiple FASTags were active for the same vehicle number. I reported this to Spinny customer support right away and requested them to get the previous owner's FASTag closed. As per the previous FASTag issuer, it only takes 2 working days if the previous owner initiates the closure request. I also requested Spinny to connect me with the previous owner so the issue could be resolved quickly, but they refused. Instead of helping, I was simply told to wait 15 days. During this time, I have been forced to pay full toll charges every day, resulting in unnecessary financial loss. What is even more frustrating is that I later learned that under the NHAI One Vehicle One FASTag policy, issuing a new FASTag without properly closing the old one can lead to the previous tag being blacklisted/deactivated automatically. Despite this, Spinny has not taken any proactive steps to resolve the issue and continues to ask me to wait, even though the actual closure process takes only a few minutes for the previous owner to initiate. I expected much better after-sales support from a company that promotes a hassle-free car buying experience. Unfortunately, once the sale was completed, resolving a genuine customer issue became extremely difficult. Very disappointed with the customer service and after-sales support. I hope Spinny takes ownership of this issue and resolves it instead of making customers suffer for something that should have been handled before delivering the car.

⭐☆☆☆☆ Very bad experience with Spinny. This is one of the worst used car sellers I have dealt with. They claim to inspect their cars thoroughly, but in my experience they did not properly check the vehicle's condition or verify its service history before selling it. Within just 20 days of purchasing the car, the engine overheated and the vehicle broke down due to a major engine problem. When I had the car inspected by a local mechanic, I was told there were multiple issues that should have been identified before the sale. Based on my experience, I feel I was misled about the condition of the vehicle. When I contacted Spinny customer support, they refused to acknowledge the problems or provide a satisfactory resolution. The support team was unhelpful, and Mr. Shilten's behavior was unprofessional and rude. The sales staff were friendly only until the sale was completed. After that, they showed no interest in resolving my concerns. I even tried escalating the matter to the CEO. Only after that did the company ask for my details, but by then I had already lost confidence in their customer service. I would not recommend Spinny to anyone looking for a reliable used car. Please get the vehicle inspected by an independent mechanic and verify the complete service history before making a purchase.

title: I purchased a Hyundai Grand i10 Sportz…
review: I purchased a Hyundai Grand i10 Sportz (2016 Model, UP24 registration number) through Spinny. However, it has been more than 20 months and the vehicle ownership has still not been transferred to my name. As per my understanding, there is also a dispute between Spinny and the first owner regarding the vehicle transfer process, due to which I am facing continuous inconvenience and financial risk. Despite multiple follow-ups, I have not received a satisfactory resolution from the company. Due to the prolonged delay and lack of support, I have been compelled to serve a legal notice and initiate legal action against both Spinny and the first owner to protect my rights. Based on my experience, I would advise buyers and sellers to thoroughly verify all ownership and transfer-related documents before dealing with this company. I hope the matter is resolved at the earliest through the appropriate legal process.
